manifestNote: Cloud-view evidence captured against the production deployment https://schedule.breadtm.xyz/, recorded separately from the 2026-09-05 localhost screenshot set (docs/screenshots/screenshots.json) so the original 5-September anchor stays intact. Every screenshot entry carries its own image SHA-256, pixel size, fixture hash, locale, browser version, viewport and capture timestamp. Share secrets used to open the share view are deliberately not recorded: the share id is recorded, the secret is omitted exactly as in docs/data/cloud-verification.json.
